title: 3D transitions ease in and out of the picture instead of slamming over it or spinning through black
goal: The 3D transitions (push in depth, cube, flip, swing, doorway, revolve) cover the picture at once with a hard, fully solid plane, and for most of their length the frame is mostly black around a spinning panel. They should carry the eye from one shot to the next: the incoming shot fades and settles in, depth reads through shadow and light rather than empty black, and a shot that has been framed or tilted keeps its framing through the move.

Push in depth arrives as a full opacity plane over the title; flip's middle frame is almost all black; the framed clip's tilt is dropped through the swing (incoming) and the flip (outgoing) and pops back after. Export measure (Scripts/depth-transition-measure.mjs, 30 fps, pillarbox bars are 0.127 of the frame): worst black in the middle half pushInDepth 0.94 (title page is black), cube 0.69, swing 0.44, flip 0.96, doorway 0.28, revolve 0.54; hitches pushInDepth 6, doorway 4, revolve 4. Render measure on stand-ins (DepthTransitionEaseRenderTests): biggest coverage jump revolve 0.162, doorway 0.191; middle black flip 0.934, cube 0.685, pushInDepth 0.537, revolve 0.490, swing 0.292, doorway 0.262; hitches doorway 6, revolve 4.

Adversarial pass before building: (1) a blurred backdrop over a pillarboxed recording must stay inside the clip's own box or the black bars would flash blurred colour during the move and pop back after; (2) an edit that has its own picture under the clips (the backdrop task) must show that, not our blur; (3) a framed card cannot have its tilt folded into one LayerTurn3D (two turns about different pivots), so the transition's turn goes on a pass-through group that keeps its contents in space and the card keeps its own; (4) the doorway's doors are windows on the shot, so a tilted card with a shadow would be clipped at the door edges unless the windows reach past the card; (5) the kinds' curve (cubic 0.4,0,0.2,1) puts p=0.5 at t=0.35, so a fade defined in progress has to be checked in time. 'Opacity eases in over at least the first quarter of the move' is read as: from the frame the incoming shot first shows, its opacity takes at least a quarter of the move's time to reach full.

Built in Layer.depthTransitionDrawn (Sources/PhotonzCore/DepthTransitions.swift): DepthTransitionPart gained light (cosine falloff to 0.45 edge on) and lift (sin of progress, nought at both ends); every incoming shot fades in (smoothstep, set per kind so it spans at least a quarter of the time on the kinds' 0.4,0,0.2,1 curve); doorway re-timed on acos(1-2p)/pi so its reveal is even; revolve's pop at 0.3 is a fade to 0.85. Drawn planes are darkened by a colour grade's exposure and, if the clip has no shadow, cast a soft one scaled by lift. A clip with its own tilt is drawn inside a pass-through group (keeps3D) that takes the move's turn, so both turns compose; door windows reach past a card that hangs over its box. transitionPartner now carries turn3D, so a tilted clip arrives tilted through every kind, flat ones included. Backdrop: given the canvas and nothing of the edit's drawn under the clips (DocumentTime and EditPointTransitions decide; the borrowed clip does not count), two whole-frame shots get blurred, dimmed (-1 stop) copies in their own boxes; otherwise the canvas glows with them, swelling with sin(p*pi). Chose the shots themselves over a fixed colour because it needs no setting and matches what is in the edit; chose to glow behind framed cards over leaving black because the intake's black-void flip was a framed card.
